title: Knowledge Factory Canonical Figure
description: Provider-independent canonical representation of an educational figure for MathVerse rendering, explanation, animation, and modification.

id.description: Stable canonical identifier for the figure.

caption.description: Caption associated with the figure in the source document.

description.description: Provider-independent textual description of the figure.

figure_type.description: High-level classification of the figure. Recommended values include geometry_diagram, coordinate_plot, function_graph, chart, number_line, venn_diagram, set_diagram, transformation_diagram, physics_diagram, circuit_diagram, chemical_structure, and other.

related_concepts.description: Concept identifiers or concept names related to this figure.

labels.description: Known labels appearing in or associated with the figure.

geometry.description: Provider-independent geometric representation used to render or reconstruct the figure.

coordinate_system.description: Optional coordinate system used by the figure.

type.description: Coordinate system type, for example cartesian, polar, or custom.

elements.description: Drawable elements that compose the figure.

rendering.description: Rendering preferences or rendering hints for MathVerse.

renderer.description: Suggested renderer, for example svg, canvas, mathverse_native, or custom.

educational.description: Educational meaning and instructional usage of the figure.

purpose.description: Examples include concept_explanation, worked_example, problem_solving, visualisation, comparison, proof, or assessment_support.

importance.description: Suggested importance such as primary, supporting, optional, or contextual.

interaction.description: Capabilities supported when MathVerse tutors or students interact with the figure.

provenance.description: Provider-independent information describing where the figure came from.

source.description: Source origin, for example document, generated, reconstructed, or derived.

provider.description: Optional extraction provider. This field is provenance only and must not affect canonical semantics.

type.description: Drawable primitive. Recommended values include point, line, ray, line_segment, vector, triangle, rectangle, square, circle, ellipse, polygon, quadrilateral, parallelogram, trapezium, trapezoid, rhombus, arc, sector, chord, tangent, axes, curve, function_graph, coordinate_plot, bar_chart, line_chart, pie_chart, number_line, venn_diagram, set_diagram, transformation_diagram, physics_diagram, circuit_diagram, chemical_structure, or a future extension.

shape.description: Optional subtype or semantic shape classification.

properties.description: Shape-specific properties such as radius, width, height, angle, slope, equation, or units.

type.description: Examples include intersects, tangent_to, parallel_to, perpendicular_to, contains, connected_to, or derived_from.
